spans.s: --the six limbs of the state including the king who must protect it with great care. M. २२०. २१; वा. ३०. २९३; ९९. ३९.
--one versed in the six supplementary sciences of the Vedas, fit for श्राद्ध. Vi. III. १५. 2.
--a king to be expert in. Br. IV. २१. ५३.

--born out of the left side of the belly of उमा;

born at शरवण in कैलास.
2: वा. ४१. ३७.

--the sixteenth kalpa; the sages, called षड्जनस्. वा. २१. ३४.

--a particular scale (music);

fourteen kinds of.
2: Ib. ८६. ४९; Vi. II. १४. ३२.
